name: The Spell Incident
source:
You are a witch who lives a busy life. At the surface, you are a student in the Witch Academy. At the underground market, you sell magic portions to clients of masked identities.

Recently, you accumulated some academic and social problems. To make things worse, you were under a spell which caused strange things happening around you.

At Halloween, you stay at home, yet a surprising visitor come and disrupt your plan.

[From [url=https://lunikadev.itch.io/the-spell-incident]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是一名日程繁忙的魔女：表面上，你是魔女学院的一名普通学生；背地里，你却在地下黑市向隐瞒身份的神秘客人们兜售魔法药剂。

最近，你在学业与人际交往上接连攒下了一堆麻烦。雪上加霜的是，你还中了一道咒语，导致身边怪事频发。

万圣节当晚，你原本打算老老实实待在家里，一位意料之外的访客却突然登门，彻底打乱了你的计划。

[摘自[url=https://lunikadev.itch.io/the-spell-incident]itch.io[/url]]
